resolved_config.matching: Archived physical inputs including original p/z, cues, order, query targets and noise draws; C0 uses the exact original input arrays. Each model keeps its own slow parameters, local gain and readout. Reset P/L per episode, construct memories online, freeze terminal state during queries.
resolved_config.new_execution: Only C0 for each seed: 256 generic episodes and the original 77 Liu participants. A0/Ae/Ce reuse committed raw arrays and canonical summaries. No training or new participants.
resolved_config.observation: Inherited sigma=1/7, replay0 only. No new observation draws, no replay averaging. Original input retains the p/z scaffold.
resolved_config.primary: Global native Hodge orders of all 77 subjects; inherited orientation and stable tie ordering. Full and conditional sampled routes are fixed secondary reports.
